intermediate.name: Santa María de Trassierra
intermediate.title: Sprint | Santa María de Trassierra (78.5 km)

story: Stage 15, shortened due to heat, saw an early breakaway of 11 riders gradually reeled in by Team Visma | Lease a Bike. Only Leknessund remained ahead, later joined by Debruyne, Nys, Romele, and van Aert. A second chase of 12 riders failed to close the gap. Van Aert won the sprint, securing Team Visma’s fifth stage victory in this Vuelta.
